program_name: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS), Shah Alam

fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM570,475. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0003089/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: SPM: Five (5) Bs in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics or Additional Mathematics, and another subject. GCE O-Level: Five (5) Bs in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics or Additional Mathematics, and another subject. UEC: Minimum B4 in three (3) subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Mathematics, Additional Mathematics. STPM: Grades BBB, ABC, or AAC or CGPA 3.0 in three (3) subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Mathematics. A-Level: Grades BBB, ABC, or AAC in three (3) subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Mathematics. Matriculation/Foundation: CGPA 3.0 in Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Mathematics. Other qualifications: Recognised by MSU Senate. English Proficiency: MUET Band 3 (local), IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL 550 (international).
